On its own a failure here is trivial, but the circuit matters more than the lamp does: because it is fed from the same fuse as the rest of the interior lighting, a short inside this small socket blows that fuse and takes the dome lamp, door courtesy lamps and luggage compartment lamp down with it, and technicians hunting a total interior lighting failure regularly overlook the sun visor as the source.

parts.role_en: This head unit is the hub of the whole infotainment system, handling radio reception, Bluetooth telephony, smartphone projection and the rendering of the reversing camera image on its touchscreen. A unit that freezes or loses touch response therefore causes far more than a loss of music: the reversing camera view and, on many trims, the climate control interface disappear at the same time, and on a car whose secondary controls live almost entirely inside the screen this becomes both a serious usability problem and a genuine hazard when manoeuvring.

parts.role_en: The external amplifier takes the low-level line signal from the head unit and boosts it to the power level needed to drive the speakers, applying crossover filtering and equalisation per channel along the way, which is what distinguishes the premium audio option from the base system. When it overheats into protection or an output stage fails, individual channels go silent, volume surges unpredictably or the sound distorts badly, and because the head unit's display continues to behave completely normally the fault is very often misdiagnosed as a blown speaker.

parts.role_en: The front door speaker reproduces the midrange and lower frequencies that carry most of what a listener perceives as sound quality, and it is mounted in the door so that the cavity behind it can act as an enclosure. That location is also its weakness: when the door's plastic vapour barrier tears or the drain holes block, the cone absorbs moisture and warps, so the speaker first sounds muddy and distorts at higher volume and eventually goes silent altogether, often making it the earliest visible evidence that the door seal has failed.

parts.role_zh: 唯一直接接触玻璃的部件，靠橡胶刮唇的锐利边缘把水刮成一层薄膜。橡胶老化硬化后刮唇翻不过来，会留下大片水痕和“吱吱”异响，严重老化露出骨架金属时还会直接在前挡玻璃上划出无法修复的弧形划痕。

parts.role_en: The exterior mirror provides the view along the right flank of the car and is the driver's primary means of checking that area before changing lane, while packaging motorised glass adjustment, powered folding, a heating element and a turn signal repeater into one small housing. Stripped plastic gears in the folding drive are its most common failure, announced by a continuous clacking as the mirror tries and fails to reach its stop, and the resulting loose mounting leaves the glass permanently trembling at speed.

Its most common long-term problem starts out of sight: the drain holes along the bottom edge clog with dirt so water collects inside the cavity and rusts the panel from the inside out, which means that by the time bubbling paint appears on the visible outer skin the inner structure is usually already badly perforated.

That design means more separate weatherstrips and more complex joints between them than the front door has, so the rear door is the more frequent source of wind noise and water leaks, and damp rear floor carpet after rain very often traces back to a failed seal at one of these quarter window joints.

When that junction leaks, water runs down the inside of the door skin directly onto the speaker below, and this unremarkable seal is the root cause of a surprising number of mysteriously dead front door speakers.
